format_note: shape: cell (shape_origin[0] + t, shape_origin[1] + r) is in the shape iff bit t (least significant = 0) of int(shape_rows[r], 16) is set. small_primes[p] = [x0 mod p, d0 mod p or null when d0 is unconstrained mod p], for p = 2 the first entry is x0 mod 8. d0 = D + d0_index * M_d where (D, M_d) = CRT of the non-null d0 residues and of d0 = -j mod q1 q2 for every row, 0 <= D < M_d. rows = [j, q1, q2, r1, r2, rho]: with c_j = (d0 + j) / (u_j q1 q2), u_j the part of d0 + j made of primes <= B, x0 = the smallest positive CRT solution of x0 mod 8, x0 mod odd p <= B, x0 = r1 mod q1, r2 mod q2, rho mod c_j. sha256 of the plain decimal strings of x0 and d0.
